name: Playground
tagline: Spikes: an Android harness that tests on a real phone from CI, and the birthplace of lumap.
description: A scratch repository for experiments before they earn a repository of their own. The mobile harness is a small Compose app with unit and instrumented tests, built and run on a device by its own workflows. The lumap projection-mapping app started here and moved to its own repository (tochi-mba/lumap, a REX Technologies product).
